section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study (Study X) that investigated the indirect effect of body dissatisfaction on body appreciation via body image flexibility in a college-bound sample of 84 White older adolescent females. Participants self-reported height and weight for BMI calculation and completed the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS). The findings suggest that bolstering body image flexibility may support body appreciation when body dissatisfaction is present.
